hypothesis: Interpolating toward the field-trained CNN can retain label coverage with the same inference cost. The pilot control gained on the Sheikh slice while losing full-task macro-F1 and accuracy.
scope: Completed paired runs only, each interpolated from the same original in-house weights. No test data or new forward passes at deployment.
selection: Rank fractions by full validation macro-F1 within the parent single-view eligibility limits, then use the parent tie-break. When none qualify, verify the highest full validation macro-F1 in D4 for diagnosis. Evaluate one fraction from each arm at D4 and apply the same parent validation promotion limits.
